# Etterna MinaCalc runner

`official_minacalc_runner` is the Etterna 0.72.x MinaCalc binary shipped with
[nonebot-plugin-osumania-toolkit](https://github.com/LeoBlackMT/nonebot-plugin-osumania-toolkit)
(MIT). It reads note rows on stdin and prints 8 MSD skillset scores on stdout.

Replace this file only when upgrading the Etterna/MinaCalc version used for training labels.
